reviews.title: Amazing cooler!
reviews.comment: Great AIO cooler! This cooler was significantly better than my tower cooler, my tower cooler (dark rock slim) averaging around 50 to 60 Celsius, and with this cooler, it went down to 40 to 50 Celsius, granted I have a 7600x CPU, but I bought it for aesthetics, and it looks amazing of course! Installing this though, took me about 3.5 hours to try setting this up, took way too long, but the mounting wasn't so bad, it was easy, not too difficult. connectivity works just fine, needing iCUE to work properly, it had plenty of cables verifying in size but make sure you use the right one, I personally used a youtube video so I knew i didn't do anything wrong and installed it right. The only negative I'd say is that, theres so many cables, about 6 of them? compared to just 1 cable for my previous cooler but for the RGB and aesthetics? so worth it!
reviews.author: Ian Sanchez

reviews.title: Highly recommend for the gamers
reviews.comment: Built my first new PC in 10 years and chose the parts carefully as I know I won’t be able to afford another for a while.  And I wanted to go with an all White build as I like the look, especially when all the lights are set to white too.  Went with the Corsair AIO because every PC I have built for me or others I have always used Corsair and never had an issue That combined with the looks and lcs info screen made this the obvious choice.  The quality is there for everyone to see and it just feels well made When it came to installation it was very straight forward and before putting it in place I was a little concerned about the pre applied paste.  It just didn’t look like enough but I trusted Corsairs judgement on this.  Everything is included for installation on Intel and Amd bird as which I am going with an AMD 9800X3D Got it installed and finished the rest of the build and hit the switch.  Was greeted with a beautifully clear lcd screen showing the Corsair splash screen and once windows fired up I installed the Icue software to provide the temp info for the lcd. Also have to mention the ability to show images and custom graphics on the display is awesome. Everything was very easy to follow and I have to say I am very impressed with the temps.  On idle the PC sits around 30c and when in a heavy load the max I have seen it reach was 80c but on average when gaming it stays around the 50c mark Overall extremely happy with the outcome and my choice of AIO
reviews.author: Steve

reviews.title: Great AIO, Corsair makes good stuff!
reviews.comment: You know, what sold me on this was the temp display. I have a Ryzen 7 and I considered the 3 fan, but it would have been overkill. As far as cooling, this does a fantastic job. As far as system link connections, this is a game changer. I honestly don't think I'll put any other fan type in my cases in the future. 1 cable linking all my fans? What a time to be alive. I bought another fan and chained it off of one side of the radiator. If my 4000x case didn't already have AF-120s mounted to the front into a lighting core I would have replaced those as well. The system is quiet. I walk in the room and I honestly can't tell if it's on or not. Everything stays cool. The system link and lighting core sync up and the plug-ins for my gigabyte board and msi GPU work well. iCUE gets better every day. I really like that I can set device memory mode and turn off icue if necessary or in my case turn off the lighting when I lock my system and walk away. I highly recommend this AIO, but if you want even more color, the "groove" modular piece puts off even more light and you can swap it out for the LCD. The modular pieces are easy to swap.
reviews.author: Michael

reviews.title: Corsair Titan RX 360 - a standout in the AIO crowd
reviews.comment: Corsair gets a bad wrap sometimes and with a market so flooded with different AIOs, it’s rare a product stands out as much as the Titan Rx 360. The first thing that really struck was the packaging and build quality. This Titan Rx feels like a premium product, well made and packaged. Clear instructions for install. And it looks great. Beautiful, crisp screen that can show anything from GIFs to temperature or power draw. Great color from the LEDs. All of which is controlled through the Corsair iCue software which is MILES ahead of anything else I have ever used for RGB or fans. The software is clean, easy to use, with tons of options to dial in LED color, patterns, fan speed. The fans are quiet and responsive, kicking in quickly when they need to keep my 9800x3d. Have to say I am more than happy with my purchase. I feel that for the money, I got a premium quality product that does exactly what I need from it and would recommend it to others.
reviews.author: Mike

reviews.title: Excellent Cooler
reviews.comment: This is by far best aio I have tried so far! I bought this because my Deep cool 360mm aio pump failed and caused constant crashes, it was a decent cooler, but this one though is a whole different beast! Stock, before tuning my chip it would keep my Intel i7 13700k around 41c idle and 62c heavy CPU games! But after tuning in bios, I am now sitting cool around 31c idle and 38c heavy gaming full settings all ray tracing enabled! I do have push pull setup with 6 fans on the rad. The rad has some thought put into it when it comes to the fins/airflow they are perfectly spaced not smudged together allowing great airflow! Allowing it to run quite even under heavy loads, with the balanced tune on ICUE not the extreme, with these temps I have no need in the extreme setting. I am very impressed with this cooler, if you are looking for a good looking and good working cooler, this is it!
